usedFor: OneHash Chat holds conversations and contacts, and Calendly creates a booking link when “Contact Created” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Created” in OneHash Chat, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new chat contact can get a booking link made for them, so a call is one step away.

watchOut: “Contact Updated” in OneHash Chat fires on updates, so the same contact can get a second link.
